sentences.draft: In message passing, we factorize the joint posterior distribution according to Bayes' theorem and the conditional independence relationships among the variables, expressed as \begin{equation} \begin{aligned} &q(\mathbf X,\{H_k\}_{k=1}^{K},\{\alpha_k\}_{k=1}^{K}\mid\mathbf Y)\\ &\quad\propto\prod_{j=1}^{MN}p(\mathbf y_j\mid\mathbf x_j)\\ &\qquad\times\prod_{k=1}^{K} p(X_k\mid H_k,\alpha_k)q_{\rm tr}(H_k)p(\alpha_k), \end{aligned} \label{eq:working-posterior} \end{equation} where $\mathbf x_j\in\mathbb C^{KN}$ and $\mathbf y_j\in\mathbb C^Q$ denote the $j$-th column of $\mathbf X=[\mathbf x_1,\ldots,\mathbf x_{MN}]$ and $\mathbf Y=[\mathbf y_1,\ldots,\mathbf y_{MN}]$, respectively.
